title: AITWIRE
description: Business-published entity records with confirmation dates: look up, page feeds, check claims.
summary: Business-published entity records with confirmation dates: look up, page feeds, check claims.
offersHint: Business-published entity records with confirmation dates: look up, page feeds, check claims. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.aitwire.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: aitwire_entity_lookup
toolsPreview.description: Look up a business, brand, organization, person, or website's business-supplied entity record on AITWIRE by domain or name — its confirmed description, feed URLs, and proof counts, each carrying the date it was confirmed. Returns no match for entities that have not published to AITWIRE.

toolsPreview.name: aitwire_entity_feeds
toolsPreview.description: Page an entity's structured feeds on AITWIRE — products, services, articles, locations, or policies (tenant_id comes from aitwire_entity_lookup).

toolsPreview.name: aitwire_grounding
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a specific claim matches an entity's business-supplied record on AITWIRE. Returns verified / contradicted / unknown with a confidence score, so you can attribute the result.
